cohort: 100 children with cerebral palsy with a mean age of 7.23 years
finding: Patella alta was the most common skeletal deformity observed (71%) in children with cerebral palsy, while coxa vara was the least common (2%).
mod_finding: The study found that 71% of children with cerebral palsy were born via vaginal delivery, while 23% were born via caesarean section and 6% were born via forceps delivery.
